transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I was cleaning out old screenshots from my 2025 trips and found that train info I saved for the Beijing to Shanghai run—wild how fast that week went.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And then right after that I detoured to Xi'an—my notes literally just say “Xi’an attractions” like I was going to be organized for once.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and I remember obsessively refreshing that one delivery page back then—tracking number SF1234567890—because the package was supposedly “out for delivery” forever.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the Beijing–Shanghai leg, my coworker Ethan Thomas ended up on train G3 in First Class, so I just copied his setup instead of thinking about it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I’m pretty sure that G3 ride was on 2025-05-15—at least that’s what my calendar from back then shows.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Xi’an we did the Bell Tower on 2025-03-19, afternoon slot, and it was booked under Zhao Min—2 tickets—still have the confirmation screenshot somewhere.
